newsitem.title: KENYA: Nairobi bourse index eases in cautious trade.
newsitem.headline: Nairobi bourse index eases in cautious trade.

text.p: The Nairobi Stock Exchange 20-share index eased marginally on Friday amid cautious trading, bourse officials said.
The index shed 9.98 points to close at 3460.55. Turnover was posted at 17.9 million shillings ($0.33 million) on 454,460 shares compared to 17.2 million shillings on 323,202 shares.
"A lot of people look like they do not want to make a serious commitment until after the elections, and some want to wait for the budget," a dealer said.
Kenya's general elections are scheduled for later this year.
A bourse official added that some investors felt prices would ease later in the year, especially nearer to the election date which was another reason for the cautious trading in the market.
Barclays Bank gained two shillings to close at 115 while National Bank of Kenya eased to 15.40 from 16.
Brooke Bond edged a shilling to close at 125 while Rea Vipingo closed at 9 from 8.80.
Power monopoly Kenya Power & Lighting shed four shillings to close at 170 while Total Kenya eased by a shilling to close at 71.50.
Uchumi Supermarket closed at 40.50 from 40.25 while Tourism Promotion Services which is the trading name for Serena Lodges & Hotels eased to 16.50 from 16.55.
Foreign investors traded Kenya Commercial Bank at between 95 and 96 from 95.50.
